column1: # mapping_set_description: Property correspondences applied by ddi_to_cdif.py (DDI Codebook 2.5 XML -> CDIF DataDescription).
#   Structural transforms the converter performs that are not term-to-term
#   mappings (so they have no TSV row):
#   - ddi: subject ids are a minted CURIE convention: XPath-style DDI Codebook element paths (element namespace ddi:codebook:2_5). @name / @intrvl denote XML attributes.
#   - A CDIF catalog record is ADDED; dcterms:conformsTo is derived from content by detect_conformance (the cdi:InstanceVariable variables yield data_description).
#   - --fetch-headers / --fetch-file-meta pull column headers and file size/checksum from the Dataverse API to build physical mappings and spdx:checksum.
